crop.notes: Only the four-line 'TOM ALLEN' notice at the top is about Allen; the rest is an unrelated Cornhill Magazine piece, 'The Origin of Inn Signs'.

ocr.notes: Allen notice transcribed correctly; inn-signs text mostly right.

summary.suggested: The Missouri Republican carried a notice for Tom Allen, retired champion pugilist of the world, at 619 Market Street, offering a free concert and boxing by the most scientific boxers of the city every evening.

metadata.notes: Masthead: 'The Republican: St. Louis, Sunday Morning, May 27, 1888'. Before the paper became The Republic (by June 2, 1888).

facts.fact: Allen's place at 619 Market Street advertised a free concert and boxing exhibitions every evening

notes: Transcript should be trimmed to the Allen notice; the inn-signs article is unrelated.
